correctness.rationale: Every semigroup element is at+2r (0<=r<=2t), giving exact Apéry minima w_j=a ceil(j/2)+2j in residue 2j modulo a. For j<=s a gap has predecessor outside the semigroup; for j>s, the explicit neighboring residues give both neighbors inside precisely when ceil((j-s)/2)-1<=u<ceil(j/2). Summing these disjoint intervals gives floor(s(s+2)/2); Apéry floor sums give genus s(s+2), maximal Apéry representative gives F=(a^2+a-4)/2, and extreme j,u attain minimum a+1 and F. The package verifier independently checks all complete sets for 150 odd a=3..301, totaling 1,158,925 gaps and 579,425 isolated gaps. The finite computation is not used to infer the unrestricted theorem.

value.rationale: This is a complete naturally motivated classification of isolated gaps for the first nonconsecutive three-term progression with odd coprime multiplicity, following the 2024 two-generator enumeration. It identifies the exact full gap positions, quadratic cardinality, a uniform half-genus law, and extremal gaps across an infinite parameter family, rather than a finite census or arbitrary slice. Its structural Apéry-neighbor proof explains why roughly half of all gaps are isolated.
